description: Inject current workspace Taskferry context at session start and before each user turn (Kilo)

hooks.command:
if command -v taskferry >/dev/null 2>&1; then if context="$(taskferry context --format kilo-hook 2>/dev/null || taskferry context --format toon)"; then printf '%s
' "$context" | node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const raw=fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"); let out; try{const j=JSON.parse(raw); out=j.additionalContext||j.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext||raw} catch{out=raw} process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:out}}));'; else printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"taskferry context failed. Run taskferry doctor to diagnose."}}'; fi; else printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"taskferry is unavailable. Install taskferry and ensure it is on PATH, then restart Kilo Code."}}'; fi

if command -v taskferry >/dev/null 2>&1; then if context="$(taskferry context --format kilo-hook 2>/dev/null || taskferry context --format toon)"; then printf '%s
' "$context" | node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const raw=fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"); let out; try{const j=JSON.parse(raw); out=j.additionalContext||j.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext||raw} catch{out=raw} process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({additionalContext:out}));'; else printf '%s
' '{"additionalContext":"taskferry context failed. Run taskferry doctor to diagnose."}'; fi; else printf '%s
' '{"additionalContext":"taskferry is unavailable. Install taskferry and ensure it is on PATH, then restart Kilo Code."}'; fi
